subject: FP&A + Billing Ops: new Billing Manager headcount & comp package (approval thread)
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Apr 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: New Billing Ops Manager - headcount & comp band request

Hi all,

Requesting approval to open a new Billing Ops Manager (IC/manager hybrid) on the FP&A/billing team to own invoice automation, AR reconciliation, and billing integrations. This role is driven by the Q3 push to clean up billing exceptions and reduce DSO. Quick summary: 

- Role: Billing Ops Manager (reports to me)
- Level: Manager / Senior IC (comp band recommended below)
- Proposed headcount type: FT - new hire (replace planned contractor)
- Target start: mid-June (rolling interviews now)

Comp proposal (market & hiring urgency taken into account):
- Base: $140,000 - $170,000
- Target total comp (on-target + bonus/eq): ~$170k - $210k
- Hiring rationale: expected to reduce avg DSO by 8-12 days within 12 months, reduce manual billing effort by ~0.5 FTE across RevOps and Finance.

Attachments: billing-manager-comp-band.pdf (market comps + recommended bands) and headcount-schedule.xlsx (cost & timeline).

Asking for: 1) headcount approval to post and 2) confirmation of the comp cap for offers (we may need to go to VP approval if we want >$170k base).

If you need more granularity on total cost (burdened), Marissa can weigh in.

Thanks,
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of RevOps | Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Apr 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New Billing Ops Manager - headcount & comp band request

Thanks Vivek — clear ask. A few follow-ups before I greenlight: 

1) Burdened cost: please include a 12-month fully loaded number (salary + benefits + equipment + recruiting fees). If Marissa can attach that line item to the headcount-schedule.xlsx that will speed approval.
2) Business case: can you add a short quant (expected DSO improvement = $ impact to cash) and who on Sales/CS will be responsible for downstream ownership?
3) Comp band: I prefer we keep the base cap at $170k without VP sign-off unless the candidate has an unusual background. If you think market makes higher offers necessary, include at least two comps showing why.
4) Hiring timeline: what is the interview loop and who are the interviewers? HR needs to confirm interview panel before posting.

If Marissa confirms the burdened numbers and the P&L delta looks reasonable, I can approve the headcount and comp band up to $170k base. Anything >$170k will need Laura's sign-off.

Neha
Neha Kapoor
VP, FP&A | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 16 Apr 2026 08:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New Billing Ops Manager - headcount & comp band request

Adding the requested numbers — attached headcount-schedule.xlsx (tab: Billing Manager). High-level: 

- Fully loaded first-year cost (base + benefits + recruiting estimate + eq): $210,400 at a $160k base.
- At $170k base, first-year fully loaded is ~$222,900.
- We modeled conservative productivity: reduction in manual billing time saves ~0.4 FTE in year 1 (savings ~$85k), plus DSO improvement modeled as increased cash flow of ~$120k in year 1 (conservative).
- Net first-year budget impact (after modeled savings) at $160k base: ~$5k incremental cost; at $170k base: ~$17k incremental cost.

Notes: If the role also picks up contract billing automations currently in RevOps backlog, there is upside to the P&L. I've added a link to the Drive folder with the runbook and the candidate scorecard template.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0A1b2c3d4e5f6

Let me know if you want me to rerun the model with alternate start dates or recruiter fee assumptions.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Finance Manager, FP&A | Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 17 Apr 2026 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New Billing Ops Manager - headcount & comp band request

Thanks team — reviewed Marissa's model. I approve the headcount to proceed to posting and interviews with the following conditions: 

- Base offer cap at $170k without my explicit sign-off. If Vivek needs to go above $170k, escalate to me with the candidate comp benchmark and a short rationale.
- Final offer should include a 6-month performance checkpoint tied to the DSO / automation milestones Marissa referenced.
- Copy Legal on the final offer language for any discretionary bonus or sign-on.

Vivek — please loop in HR and our external recruiting partner (Elisabeth). HR Ops should create the job in Greenhouse and share the interview plan. If recruiting risk is high, consider a 3-month contractor while we finish the search (Marissa, put contractor cost in the schedule if needed).

If everyone agrees, Neha can mark as approved for headcount in Workday and we can begin candidate interviews.

Laura
Laura Bennett
VP Finance | Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>

Subject: Fwd: FP&A + Billing Ops: new Billing Manager headcount & comp package (approval thread)

Forwarding the approved headcount to kickoff recruiting. See key stipulations from Finance: base cap $170k without VP sign-off; include a 6-month performance checkpoint tied to DSO and automation milestones. Target start date: 2026-06-15 (flexible).

Attachments: offer-draft.docx (template) — please prepare initial outreach messaging and candidate screening questions. Elisabeth — please prioritize profiles that fit the $150k-$170k base band; include at least three references that have billing automation experience.
